incidents.title: Mass-balance gap at Acme Riverside
incidents.narrative: Riverside writes 1,857.4 lb issued and 55.8 lb waste on every Cal-Mag batch, so 115.199 kg over BR-A-2201 and BR-A-2204 is in neither the tablets nor the recorded waste.

incidents.title: Mock supplier recall candidate
incidents.narrative: Hollow Pine bought 2,500 kg of ascorbic acid from Ridgeway in one winter order and sent 1,000 kg of the lot to Riverside for its late-winter Vitamin C. The lot went into Vitamin C batches at both plants, so it is the one a mock supplier recall notice traces.

incidents.title: Packaging freight surcharge
incidents.narrative: Packaging carriers added a fuel surcharge of $85 a delivery from May through July.

incidents.title: Holiday shutdown
incidents.narrative: The plant closes for two days at the end of December: no batches, no trucks.

priceDrift.sentence: Pacific Excipient Co. billed silicon dioxide at $7.2413/kg on RV-PO-0039, up 12.4% on its $6.440336/kg trailing price (RV-PO-0006, RV-PO-0025). It was a real, received order, so it is in the export with both prices; worth a call before the next one.
